info.title: Reader API
info.description: Reader turns any URL into clean markdown for LLMs. One endpoint (`POST /v1/read`) handles scrape, batch, and crawl operations. See https://reader.dev/docs for concepts and guides.

data.markdown:
# Example Domain

This domain is for use in illustrative examples in documents. You may use this domain in literature without prior coordination or asking for permission.

[More information...](https://www.iana.org/domains/example)

screenshot.description: Base64-encoded PNG screenshot of the full page. Only present when "screenshot" is included in formats.

ResolvedProxyMode.description: The proxy mode that actually ran: `standard` (datacenter) or `premium` (residential). Omitted on cache hits.

formats.description: Content formats to include in the response.

onlyMainContent.description: Strip navigation, footers, and boilerplate. Default: true.

maxDepth.description: Crawl depth (when crawling). Omit for single-URL scrape.

maxPages.description: Maximum pages to discover during crawl.

cache.description: Reuse cached content within TTL. Default: true.

ProxyMode.description: Proxy mode for the scrape. `standard` uses datacenter proxies (default, 1 credit); `premium` uses residential proxies for better bot bypass (3 credits).

SseStream.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each frame is a line-delimited event with an `event:` line, a `data:` line (JSON payload), and a trailing blank line. Keep-alive comments (`: ping`) are sent every 30 seconds. See [Events](/home/concepts/events) for the full event catalog.

secret.description: HMAC secret. Visible only on the create response.

post.description: Unified endpoint for all read operations. Pass `url` for a single scrape, `urls` for a batch, or `url` + `maxPages` to crawl a site.

get.description: Long-lived Server-Sent Events connection that emits real-time progress, completion, and failure events for every job in the workspace. Use this for dashboards and realtime UIs. For a single job, use `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/stream` instead.
